description_en: The DescribeDcdnErUsageData operation queries the number of times an Edge Routine (ER) is executed
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnErUsageData查询边缘函数ER的执行次数
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-er-usage-data --routine-id routine1.test --spec 50ms --start-time 2018-10-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2018-10-31T16:00:00Z --split-by routine --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnErUsageData

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Edge Routine that you want to query
parameters.name: routine_id

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the Edge Routine. Valid values:

5ms

50ms

100ms
parameters.help_zh:
查询指定的边缘函数规格。取值：

5ms

50ms

100ms
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The dimension by which you want to group the query results. You can group the results by Edge Routine ID (routine) or specification (spec).

If you leave this parameter empty, the query results are not grouped
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果分组输出，可以按照函数ID（routine）或函数规格（spec）分组输出。

若参数为空，查询结果不分组
parameters.name: split_by

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
